text:
maya: Quick sync — Datadog + OTEL dashboard bundle for the marketplace + HW partner demo. Need a short pre-announce checklist and who can own smoke tests this week.
aj: I can run smoke tests for traces and spans on our internal perf cluster. Will need a sample workload & the exporter config.
dani: I'll draft the announcement blurb once we lock the bundle assets. Who's recording the demo video for the marketplace listing?
rachel: I can record a 2-min clip showing trace + latency panels, and the GPU trace enrichment. Need the dashboard URL and a lightweight service to hit.
amy (Datadog): happy to help with the dashboard templates and provide an embed snippet for the marketplace tile. I can push the JSON templates by EOD Thu.
tom: FYI the HW SI asked for a short runbook for on-site demos — they want the OTEL collector flags and recommended sampling. I'll paste a minimal config below.
otel-bot: CI: otel-exporter-e2e passed on linux-perf-3 (build 4821) :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks Amy. Tom — can you drop that runbook config here? We'll include in partner docs.
tom: sure — minimal config:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    apikey: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
aj: perfect. For smoke tests I'll use the perf harness with 100 concurrent connections, 10s bursts. Want me to also validate prefix caching on our side?
maya: yes validate prefix caching and KV cache warmup. Also confirm failover to smaller quantized model in fallback. We need evidence for the release notes.
dani: For the release notes: short bullets — marketplace dashboard, sample OTEL config, demo video, and HW SI runbook. I'll compile once I get the assets.
amy (Datadog): I'll add a note about recommended Datadog APM settings (span tags to include: model_id, gpu_type, batch_size). I'll share the JSON mappings.
rachel: timeline check — recording today after aj's tests finish? I can stitch clips and add captions.
aj: aiming to finish smoke by 15:30 PT. If green I'll post the perf logs and a short summary.
maya: green plan: if smoke passes we sign off on docs + video and schedule a dry-run with HW SI Fri 10:00 PT.
tom: I'll prepare the dry-run checklist: collector install, env vars, firewall ports, and a short troubleshooting section.
otel-bot: Reminder: runbook template updated in /docs/partners/otel-runbook.md by tom @ 1745679005
maya: awesome — action items: aj run tests, amy push dashboard JSON, rachel record, tom prep runbook, dani draft release bullets. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
aj: on it — will post results in this thread.
amy (Datadog): pushing dashboard JSON in the marketplace repo now -> link: https://git.internal/marketplace/dd-otel-templates
rachel: recording done — uploaded clip to GDrive and added to the doc.
dani: draft bullets in google doc, sharing shortly.
maya: last ask — can someone validate sample log->trace linking? small check only.
aj: did a quick check, logs are linking using trace_id -> looks good.
maya: great, thanks everyone. I'll schedule the dry-run invite and loop in the HW SI lead. :sparkles:
